ui.footer: The Urantia Book for Young Readers · Jay Han
p0.002: People who live on our world, Urantia (the name for the Earth), use words like God, divinity, and deity all the time, but they often mean different things by them, and that gets confusing. So the heavenly beings who wrote this book wrote a Foreword first, to settle the meanings of the important words before we read the main text. You could say the Foreword is a ‘dictionary’ for reading this book. They admit that it is hard to explain such great truths in a human language like English, and they say they will make up new words only when there is simply no fitting word.
p0.003: The Foreword also gives us a map of the universe showing where we live. Urantia belongs to a local universe called Nebadon, and Nebadon belongs to a superuniverse called Orvonton. Seven superuniverses like Orvonton circle around Havona, the perfect central universe that has no beginning and no end, and at its very center is the motionless Isle of Paradise, where God dwells. The central universe and the seven superuniverses together are called the grand universe, and when we add the universes still being made out beyond them, the whole thing is called the master universe.
p0.005: First, the Foreword tells apart ‘Deity’ and ‘divinity.’ Deity can show itself as God, in a personal way, and it also exists in ways that are prepersonal or superpersonal, beyond what people can fully understand. Deity is the source of everything that is divine. But not everything divine is Deity. Divinity is the quality of Deity, the quality that unites everything and brings it into harmony. We can sense divinity as truth, beauty, and goodness, and also as love, mercy, and ministry.
p0.006: The Foreword says Deity works on seven levels, and it divides reality into three layers: the finite, which has a beginning; the absonite, which has no beginning and no end and goes beyond time and space; and the absolute, which has neither time nor space. It also explains that there are different kinds of perfection, and sorts them into seven kinds, from what is perfect in every way to what is still imperfect in every way.
p0.008: The word ‘God’ refers to every case in which Deity shows itself as a person. In this book, “⟦Q 0:2.10⟧The term God always denotes personality⟦/Q⟧”. ‘Deity,’ on the other hand, may or may not be personal. And when it is not clear who is meant by God, you can take it to mean the Universal Father.
p0.009: In this book the word God is used in seven ways. The first three are God the Father, who created all things (the Universal Father); God the Son (the Eternal Son); and God the Spirit, who gives mind (the Infinite Spirit). To these are added God the Supreme, who is growing in time and space; God the Sevenfold, a sevenfold path that reaches out to us; God the Ultimate, who will appear in the realms beyond time and space; and God the Absolute, on the very highest level.
p0.010: 3. III. The First Source and Center
p0.011: At the root of all reality are seven ‘Absolutes.’ An Absolute is a most basic reality that depends on nothing else. The seven are the First, Second, and Third Sources and Centers (the Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit), the Isle of Paradise, the Deity Absolute, the Universal Absolute, and the Unqualified Absolute. Among them, God, the First Source and Center, is the foundation of everything, so nothing can exist apart from him.
p0.012: Material gravity pulls toward Paradise, mind gathers to the Infinite Spirit, spirit gathers to the Eternal Son, and all personality centers on the Universal Father. Because people think in time, the Foreword says, things that happened all at once in eternity have to be explained one after another. The name ‘I AM’ is also a way of speaking for our sake, since it is hard for us to understand a being without a beginning. Only the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit truly know the Father as infinite; for every other being, that is a matter of faith.
p0.014: Reality, everything that truly exists, begins in the will of the Universal Father. Reality is divided broadly into ‘deified reality,’ which has to do with Deity, and ‘undeified reality,’ such as energy, which is not Deity, and the Universal Absolute connects the two. The Foreword also tells apart what is actual, already showing itself, and what is potential, yet to grow. The Eternal Son is spirit that is fully actual, but a human being is still mostly spiritual possibility that has not yet come true.
p0.015: The Isle of Paradise is the source of all the material universes. Yet Paradise is not a creator, and it is not Deity. It is the only motionless place in the universe, and the Foreword says that “⟦Q 0:4.13⟧it is just Paradise⟦/Q⟧”.
p0.017: Personality is a gift from the Universal Father. Personality does not appear by itself, and something impersonal never turns into a personality. A human being is made up of body, mind, spirit, soul, and personality. The body is the physical form made of matter, and the mind is what thinks and feels. The spirit is the spirit of God that comes to live in our minds, the Thought Adjuster.
p0.018: The soul is not there from birth; it grows as we live. When we choose to “⟦Q 0:5.10⟧do the will of the Father in heaven⟦/Q⟧”, the Thought Adjuster and our mind together give birth to a new soul. This soul is neither material nor spiritual but morontial (morontia is the stage between material and spiritual life), and it survives death. Personality is the unchanging ‘I’ that ties all of these together.
p0.020: There are four circuits in the universe. Whatever responds to the Father’s personality circuit is personal; whatever responds to the Son’s spirit circuit is spirit; whatever responds to the Infinite Spirit’s mind circuit is mind; and whatever responds to Paradise gravity is matter. The words energy and force are used broadly, and material energy passes through the stages of cosmic force, emergent energy, and universe power before it becomes the matter we know. Mind links spirit and matter, and the universe is lit by material light, the light of wisdom, and the light of spirit.
p0.021: A pattern is the model, the original, from which copies are made. Paradise is the absolute pattern, and the Eternal Son is the pattern of personality. A pattern can give energy its shape, but it does not control energy. Only gravity controls energy and matter.
p0.023: There are two kinds of Deity. God the Father, God the Son, and God the Spirit are ‘existential’ Deities, who have been there from the beginning and are eternal. God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and God the Absolute, on the other hand, are ‘experiential’ Deities, who are being completed together with the growing universe. They have a beginning, but no end.
p0.024: The Supreme Being is the God who is now growing in time and space. He is the one who gathers into one all the experience that Creators and creatures go through together. All the experience and growth of finite beings like us are gathered up in the Supreme Being, until at last the finite and the infinite are joined as one.
p0.026: We have so many limits that we cannot reach God all at once. So the Universal Father has provided a path of seven steps, God the Sevenfold. The seven are the Paradise Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, the Seven Master Spirits, the Supreme Being, God the Spirit, God the Son, and God the Father.
p0.027: Our journey begins with getting to know the Creator Son of our own local universe. Next we pass through the Ancients of Days and the Master Spirits, who rule the superuniverse, and at last we meet the Universal Father on Paradise. The Creator Son opens the way for mortal beings to become immortal beings.
p0.029: Just as the Supreme Being grows in the grand universe, God the Ultimate is God appearing in a wider realm beyond time and space. If the Supreme Being is the form of God that finite beings can understand, God the Ultimate is the form of God that the still higher absonite beings can understand. He, too, has a beginning but no end, the God who will be forever.
p0.031: God the Absolute is the form that Deity is reaching through experience on the highest, absolute level. Even the being who wrote the Foreword says this cannot be fully explained to a finite mind. God the Absolute is the goal that the highest beings are trying to reach, but it is such a far-off matter that the writer honestly admits hesitating to say much about it.
p0.033: There are three Absolutes. The Deity Absolute is the infinite possibility in which all divine activity takes place. The Unqualified Absolute is the infinite possibility of space and force, with no personality and no divinity, yet it is truly at work everywhere in the universe. The Universal Absolute connects these two, brings them into harmony, and unites them.
p0.034: Thanks to the Universal Absolute, time and eternity, the finite and the infinite, and people and God can all exist together. That is why small, finite beings like us can live in the universe of the infinite God. In the end, though the three Absolutes look separate to our eyes, in the infinite they are one Absolute.
p0.036: A Trinity is a union of Deities into one. The Paradise Trinity, formed by the Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit, has existed from the beginning and forever. In the future, experiential Trinities called the Trinity Ultimate and the Trinity Absolute are coming into being, and through them God the Ultimate and God the Absolute will be revealed.
p0.037: At the end of the Foreword, the authors explain how they are writing this book. They will build first on more than a thousand of the highest ideas already held by people who knew God, and they will add new revelation only where those are not enough. Human words can never carry all of heaven’s truth, they say, but because the spirit of God lives in our minds and the Spirit of Truth is with us, we are able to understand truth. Even if there are many hard words, if you read slowly without hurrying, these words will become guides that help you know God more deeply.
p1.002: The Universal Father is God, the beginning and the center of all universes and all beings. He is the Creator who made everything, and he is the one who keeps and cares for all that he has made. God has revealed himself to human beings, and through him we can know the source of all creation. A prophet of old said to God, “⟦Q 1:0.1⟧You have created the heaven and the heaven of heavens, with all their hosts⟦/Q⟧”. From this we can learn that God is not alone, and we can also see how great a being he is.
p1.003: 2. God Is the Creator and the Ruler
p1.004: The Universal Father did not simply make everything; he also upholds it and rules it. He made the many kinds of intelligent beings who live on countless planets in the universe so that they could know God and love him. As the text says, “⟦Q 1:0.2⟧God created the heavens and formed the earth; he established the universe and created this world not in vain; he formed it to be inhabited⟦/Q⟧”. Every created thing exists within his plan and his love. The universe we live in is one of his works, and human beings live in this universe as part of his plan.
p1.005: 3. What Is the Purpose of Human Beings?
p1.006: Every being in the universe sets out on a journey to find God. Human life is not just a matter of living for a while and then passing away; it is an eternal adventure. The final goal of that adventure is to find God, to understand him, and to become like him. God has said to us, “⟦Q 1:0.6⟧Be you perfect, even as I am perfect⟦/Q⟧”. These words are a challenge for us to grow spiritually, to discover our true selves, and in the end to reach a high level like God’s.
p1.008: God is a being of perfect divinity, and he has told human beings to make this their goal. Even though we cannot be perfect in the way God is, within his plan we have the possibility of reaching a divine goal. When people reach this goal, they become perfect, just as God is perfect. But this perfection is not a material thing; it happens in our will and in our spirit. Even within our physical limits, we can come closer to God through spiritual growth.
p1.010: In the universe God is called by many names, but he is one and the same. He has many roles, such as Creator, Controller, and Upholder, and he is known by different names on different worlds. For example, in one place God is called ‘the Father of Lights,’ and in another he is called “⟦Q 1:1.4⟧the Infinite Upholder⟦/Q⟧”. Whatever we call him, what matters is having a personal relationship with him, feeling his love, and worshiping him.
p1.011: 6. The Relationship Between God and Human Beings
p1.012: God does not force people to follow him. He wants us to love him and follow him of our own free will. Following God is the very best gift we can give him, and that gift is our heart and our will. When a person chooses to follow God, it leads to true worship. This worship is not material but spiritual, and it comes about through our free choice.
p1.014: God is not a material being but a spiritual one. He is everywhere in the universe, yet we cannot see him with our eyes. Still, we can sense that he is there through the things he has created. God shows himself to us in many ways, but his nature is spiritual. Only with our spiritual eyes can we recognize God. God is also present throughout all the universes, and his spiritual power is connected with every being.
p1.016: God’s nature is a mystery that human beings can never fully understand. With our limited knowledge we cannot know all of his infinite nature and power. But God is with us, and his mystery is gradually revealed when we try to seek him. God is present within the human mind, and his spirit walks with us. This spiritual connection makes our lives eternal and draws us into a deeper connection with God.
p1.017: 9. The Personality of the Universal Father
p1.018: God is not just energy; he is a personal being. He loves us and wants to have a relationship with us. God pours out his love on us, and we can have fellowship with him. The relationship between God and human beings is like the relationship between parents and children. We love God, and by trying to become like him we can grow closer to him. Even though we cannot see God with our eyes, we can clearly feel his love and his personality.
p1.019: 10. The Journey People and God Take Together
p1.020: People should make an effort to seek God in their lives. This journey can be long and hard, but God is always with us. As we follow God’s will, we learn his wisdom and love, and we grow spiritually. Fellowship with God is not just a duty; it makes our lives rich and leads us on our journey toward eternal life. People who know God find true happiness and peace in their relationship with him.
p1.022: The Universal Father is the source of all beings and the Creator who loves us. Human beings set out with him on a spiritual journey and try to find him and understand him. God has a personal relationship with each of us; he guides us and makes our lives rich. Our purpose is to come closer to God, to feel his love, and to become perfect as he is. This journey is an eternal adventure, but God is always with us and will guide us all the way to the end.
p2.002: God’s nature is that of an infinite and eternal personality, full of love, justice, and mercy. We can understand God’s nature in many ways, but the best example of all is the life Jesus showed us. Jesus explained God’s love and justice in a way people could understand.
p2.003: To understand God’s nature, we can think of God as our Father. He is our Creator and our spiritual Father. Because God is infinite, it is hard for us to understand him completely, but we can come to know him through his love and mercy.
p2.005: God is infinite. He knows everything, and he is everywhere. His wisdom and his plans are greater and deeper than anyone can imagine. He created all the universes and made the rules by which they run. God is not held back by human limits, and his sense of time is different from ours. We think of the past, the present, and the future separately, but for God all time exists as one.
p2.006: God lets his infinity reach human beings in many ways. Sometimes he becomes a person, as Jesus did, and sometimes he sends beings like the angels to help us. And the spirit of God lives within our minds and is always with us.
p2.008: God is perfect. He does not change, and he can always be trusted. God’s plans do not change, and his purposes are always eternal. His commands are perfect, and everything he does is divine and without error.
p2.009: We cannot be perfect the way God is, but God understands our imperfection and shows us mercy and love. He guides us to become better beings. God also understands human imperfection deeply, and through that experience he wants to grow even closer to us.
p2.011: God is fair. His justice never changes, and everything he does is righteous. When people do wrong, they must take responsibility for it, but because God is merciful, he gives us the chance to repent. God hates sin, but he loves the sinner.
p2.012: God gives us justice and mercy at the same time, and he makes the right decision in every situation. When he judges us, he takes our weaknesses and our circumstances into account. So God’s justice is not just about punishment; it works within a greater plan that includes mercy.
p2.014: God is full of love, and his mercy has no end. He understands our weakness and our mistakes, and he forgives us with mercy. His mercy is always so open toward us that we do not even need to beg God for forgiveness. Just as people find it easier to forgive each other when they understand each other, God understands us completely, so he is always ready to forgive.
p2.015: In his love God always takes care of us, and when we suffer, he suffers with us. His mercy is poured out on us without end, and he waits for us to repent and come back to him.
p2.017: God is love. His love surrounds all the universes and every being in them. God has shared his own life with us, and he hopes that everyone will find him. His love has no conditions, and anyone may come to him.
p2.018: God loves us as his sons and daughters, and he has sent his spirit to live within us. We can feel his love, follow his will, and grow in that love. His love has no conditions, and he always works to bring about good for his children.
p2.020: God is good, and his goodness shows itself best in our spiritual experience. God is fair and moral, and we can trust his goodness. His goodness is bound up with his love, and in that love we can feel and experience God’s goodness.
p2.021: God comes to us as a good being, and he leads us to follow his goodness and live lives in which we do good to others. Through his goodness God gives people joy and peace.
p2.023: God is the source of truth and beauty. Truth and beauty come from God’s nature, and we can find them in what he has created. Truth shows itself through beauty, and beauty is made complete through truth.
p2.024: When we seek truth, we come to understand God better and experience his beauty. All truth, beauty, and goodness are in harmony within God’s love, and in human life they are united as one.
p3.002: God is everywhere in the universe. His presence reaches every place, and there is nowhere in the whole universe beyond his touch. His spirit is present not only on the Earth where we live but everywhere, out to the countless stars, planets, and galaxies. God is also within our minds. We cannot see him directly, yet we can feel his presence in our lives all the time. God is always with us, and wherever we are and whatever we do, we are held in his care and love.
p3.003: In the Bible, the Psalmist says, “⟦Q 3:1.1⟧whither shall I flee from your presence?⟦/Q⟧” This means that no matter how hard we try to hide, God knows us and surrounds everything about us. And because God created all life and every being in the universe, his spirit naturally dwells within us. God is not only the Creator of the world we live in; he is also the Creator of the universe. God is with us in our everyday lives, and he is close by whenever we need him. His spirit protects us and always leads us on the right path.
p3.005: God’s power is absolute throughout the whole universe. He created all matter and energy, and he rules all of it according to his will. God’s creation of the universe is proof of his infinite power. All the laws of nature and all physical events are moved by his power. For example, the stars circling in their orbits and the changing of the seasons all happen in order, according to God’s plan. This creative power of God is not limited to material things; it applies in the same way to the spiritual world.
p3.006: God controls the universe perfectly. His power has no end and goes beyond human understanding. Even when things happen that we do not understand, all of them happen within God’s plan. Because God is all-powerful, he rules every living thing in the universe and leads them to live together in harmony. Sometimes we may face hard situations in life, but even then God is watching over us. His power always cares for us, and his plan leads us in the best direction.
p3.007: God shows his power even in natural disasters and in the many events of the universe. As the Bible puts it, God has even set the path of the lightning, and in the same way he controls and directs all energy and matter. His power does more than move energy around; it links together everything created in the universe and makes it all work in harmony.
p3.009: God knows everything. He sees into the deepest places of our hearts and knows every thought we are thinking and every worry we carry. God knows perfectly not only the past and the present but also the future. He sees every moment of our lives and knows in detail each thing we go through. God already knows what we need and which way we should go.
p3.010: The Bible says that not even one sparrow falls to the ground without God knowing it. This means that God cares about even the smallest things. In every moment of our lives, God shares our pain and sorrow and blesses our joys and successes. God knows our needs better than anyone, and he is always ready to meet them.
p3.011: God knows not only about us but also the movements of every planet and every star in the universe. He calls them all by name and understands perfectly where each one is and what each one does. The whole universe is so huge that it goes beyond human imagination, but God knows every detail of it. His knowledge is complete, and nothing can be hidden from God. God is always watching over us and guiding us so that we do not wander onto the wrong path.
p3.013: God is an infinite being. He is not limited by space or time, and he exists forever. His power has no end, and his love has no limit. God created everything in the universe, and everything he created shows his infinity. He is bigger and greater than anything we can imagine. Even while God creates new universes and cares for all of them, his power does not grow any less at all.
p3.014: God gives himself to us freely. His infinite spirit lives within us and guides us. Thanks to the free will God has given us and to his love, we can grow and make progress. God sends us his spirit and guides us through everything that happens in our lives. His spirit helps us come closer to God and lets us experience his infinite love.
p3.015: God’s infinity also shows clearly in the size of the universe he created. Countless planets and stars are under his control, and they all move within God’s order. God has also planned everything in the universe with his infinite knowledge and wisdom, and that plan does not change. His infinite love and wisdom show us the very best way and help us grow into better beings.
p3.017: God rules the universe directly, but he also carries out his will through his Sons and through many kinds of angels and spirit beings. He cares for all the universes and the creatures in them, and he leads them to work together in harmony. God has many times shared his power with other beings, but even so, the final control belongs to God. In other words, he is the Lord of the universe, and everything comes about according to his will.
p3.018: God has given his creatures free will. But even when their choices go in the wrong direction, God in the end leads them back to the right path. People sometimes face many difficulties and suffering in life, but this is one of the ways God trains us and makes us into better beings. God helps us grow, tests our faith, and helps us reach greater maturity of personality.
p3.019: God guides the destiny of each planet and world in the universe according to his will. As Jesus said, we are in God’s hand, and no one can snatch us out of his hand. In this way God is in control of everything, and his rule is carried out with love and mercy. We live under God’s protection by his wisdom, and his plan always works out in the right direction.
p3.021: Love is God’s very nature. His love has no conditions and no end. Whatever mistakes we make, God always forgives us and holds us close in love. God thinks of us as his children, and even when we go the wrong way, he waits for us and brings us back to the right path. God’s love is greater and deeper than we can imagine.
p3.022: His love touches every moment of our lives and changes our lives. We find comfort in his love, and through that love we are able to live together with other people. God has sent us his spirit, and that spirit is always guiding us from within our minds. When we are glad, God is glad with us, and when we are sad, he is sad with us.
p3.023: God does not simply love us; he wants us to become like him. We can follow the example of his love, show love to other people, and through that love make the world a better place. God’s love comforts us even when we are hurt and having a hard time, and it keeps having a good effect on our lives. His love never changes, and in that love we can find eternal peace and joy.
p4.002: God created the universe, and he manages it and takes care of it. Throughout all the universes he has an eternal purpose for everything material, intellectual, and spiritual, and he is always at work to carry out that purpose. God created the universe by his own free will, and everything he created is growing within his plan.
p4.003: One of the reasons God created Havona, the perfect central universe, was for his own joy and satisfaction. Havona is the model for all the other universes, and it is the place where beings who are made to become perfect over time, that is, mortals, are trained and grow. Even so, Havona was not created only for God’s pleasure; it is also part of the process that leads toward evolution’s final goal, moving on toward a perfect world like Paradise.
p4.004: God wants every being in this universe, including human beings, to grow and become perfect. In the universe there are countless spirit beings who serve God, follow his will, and help human beings make spiritual progress. They work according to the laws and principles God has set, and they help people move on to higher spiritual levels.
p4.006: After God created the universe, he did not just watch it from far away. He is directly involved in everything, and he manages through his providence the many events that are always happening in the universe. God’s providence shows that everything that happens in the universe is not simply chance but happens within his plan and purpose. This is true not only of the physical world but also has to do closely with human spiritual growth.
p4.007: In the past, people misunderstood God’s providence and thought of it as something random and unpredictable. But in truth God’s providence is very orderly and works in a way that is in complete agreement with his laws. Human progress and growth do not happen by chance; they happen within the providence God has planned. God is preparing the very best way for us, and we can grow and develop by following his will.
p4.008: God also has the power that holds up the universe. He upholds and cares for all matter and all spirit beings. If God were to leave the universe, it would fall into chaos at once. God is always with us, and even when we cannot see him, he keeps the universe steady. Everything that happens in our lives happens within the order God has planned.
p4.010: Nature is the way God’s laws show themselves in the material world. But nature can sometimes look confused. For example, when natural disasters or events people find hard to understand take place, we sense that nature is imperfect. This is because the universe is not yet perfect, and nature, like the evolving universe, is always changing.
p4.011: God’s laws are perfect, but when these laws are carried out on each planet or in each universe, they can be changed or twisted by many influences. For example, in some universes rebellion or mistakes have happened, and God’s plan has been delayed or made more complicated. For these reasons, nature sometimes appears in a form that is not perfect.
p4.012: But we should know that nature is not completely chaotic or unstable. Nature is growing within God’s plan, and over time it will become more perfect. God’s laws do not change, but when they are applied in each universe or on each planet, they can vary a little according to local conditions. The imperfection of nature is simply something that appears because the universe is not yet perfect, and through this process God is making the universe more and more perfect.
p4.014: God’s character does not change. He is always faithful, and his nature is perfect. People sometimes think of God as if he were a human being and imagine that he gets angry or jealous. But God is not pushed around by feelings the way people are. He has perfect love and mercy, and he never becomes angry or disappointed the way people imagine.
p4.015: In the past, people thought that events such as natural disasters and wars were God’s anger. But this idea came from a wrong understanding of God. God is absolutely fair, and he treats every being equally. His nature does not change, and his plan is always faithfully carried out.
p4.016: God still loves us in spite of our failures and mistakes, and through his plan he is helping us grow. God does not make mistakes, and he does not regret or grieve. His wisdom is perfect, and his plan does not change. Yet God has deep affection for us, and even when we fail to follow his plan, he waits for us with patience.
p4.018: God is a being who goes beyond everything, yet he comes close to us as our Father. He is an absolute being, the one who exists by himself. He does not depend on any outside power; by his own will he creates and rules the universe. God is one who does not change, yet by his will he can appear in many different ways within the universe.
p4.019: God relates to the universe by his own will and freedom. He shows us love and treats us as his children. God has perfect goodness and free will, and everything he does comes from this goodness and love. While he rules the universe, he also has a deep relationship with us as our Father.
p4.020: God is the Father of all creatures, and his love reaches throughout the whole universe. He is a being beyond any scientific or philosophical idea, and his nature is love itself. God wants us to recognize him as our Father and to come to him in love. His love is the foundation of the way he relates to every being, and through that love we can know God.
p5.002: God is very great and majestic, yet he wants to have a close relationship with each person. People can seek God and have fellowship with him. We may think God is so far away that we cannot reach him, but really it is because of our limited knowledge and experience that we cannot fully understand him. To grow spiritually and come close to God, we need a long journey. Still, God always reveals himself to us, and because his spirit dwells in our minds, we can have fellowship with him at any time.
p5.003: God treats everyone fairly and shows no favoritism. Whether a person’s place in society is high or low, whether they are rich or poor, all have the same spiritual opportunity. What we need in order to know God is a sincere heart and the will to follow him. Anyone who truly seeks God and wants to do his will can experience spiritual fellowship with God. God has fellowship with each of us through the divine spirit that dwells within us, the Thought Adjuster, and so he gives us a way to be connected with him.
p5.004: To come close to God, we need a heartfelt decision to follow his will. When we sincerely want to do God’s will, his spirit guides and protects us. It may take a long time to reach God, but we should remember that God is always with us. His spirit lives within our minds, and throughout our spiritual journey it is always watching over us and helping us.
p5.006: God is everywhere. The God who created the universe is at work in every realm, material, spiritual, and intellectual. He is at the center of the material universe and of all spirit beings, and his presence reaches throughout the whole universe. God also dwells in the human mind, and his spirit is the closest presence we can feel in everyday life. The Thought Adjuster is the way God lives directly within human beings. We do not need to look far off into the sky to meet God, because God dwells within our minds.
p5.007: Fellowship with God is a mysterious but real experience. Even though our material minds cannot fully understand God’s spiritual presence, we come to experience his presence more and more deeply as we grow spiritually. Human beings are able to have direct fellowship with the spirit of God, but this depends mostly on a person’s spiritual maturity. In other words, how deeply we can recognize his presence depends on how much we want to follow God.
p5.008: God’s presence also becomes clearer when we follow spiritual guidance and put his will into practice. Fellowship with God happens as we move beyond a material way of thinking, through a mind that has been changed spiritually. God is always at work within the human mind and guides us according to his will. In this process, through God’s spiritual guidance, we can move on to higher spiritual levels.
p5.010: Worship is an important way of having fellowship with God. When we worship God, we express our love and awe toward him. True worship is not just prayer to get something; it is recognizing who God is and being filled with wonder at his greatness. When we realize God’s love and wisdom, we worship naturally, and worship is a free response that comes from deep within us.
p5.011: Worship is different from prayer in which we ask God for something. Prayer is telling God about our needs, but worship is praising who he is. When we worship God, we praise his love, justice, and mercy, without thinking about what we hope to get or gain. True worship comes only from pure love for God, and it helps human beings grow spiritually.
p5.012: We worship God the Father, but through prayer we can also have fellowship with the Son. Through Jesus we can feel God closer to us and understand his love. When we worship God, we feel his personal love, and we long for our spiritual selves to grow closer to him. True worship is an important process that leads to spiritual maturity.
p5.014: Religion is a path that helps people discover God and build a relationship with him. Evolved religion is based on morality and love, and it leads people to become like God. But religion is not just carrying out moral duties; it is a relationship with God as a living experience. Through religion we find unity and peace in life, and we come to realize that God is our eternal destination.
p5.015: Religion also helps us make important decisions in life. Through religion we come to live lives of loving and serving our neighbors, and this makes our relationships with people richer. Religion leads people to go beyond themselves, to live in harmony with the universe, and to live lives devoted to others. Religious experience shapes a higher level of personality through moral and spiritual choices.
p5.016: Jesus taught a religion of love. He did not simply seek goodness or beauty; he lived a religion of loving God and spreading God’s love in the world. The religion of Jesus has love at its center, and it is a religion that ties together everything that is good, beautiful, and true. Through the teachings of Jesus we are called to love God and live lives of serving our neighbors.
p5.018: God-consciousness means the human ability to recognize God and have fellowship with him. Morality is the first step toward recognizing God, and through it we can tell right from wrong and make better choices. But morality alone cannot bring us to a full recognition of God. Going beyond moral choices, we can experience a deeper God-consciousness through spiritual fellowship with God.
p5.019: Religion, unlike science or art, meets the deepest spiritual needs of human nature. Science explores facts, and art seeks beauty, but religion leads people into fellowship with God. Through religious experience we can discover God and live lives of following his will. Recognizing God is a spiritual experience that reason and logic cannot explain.
p5.020: God-consciousness has three stages. First we understand the idea of God, and next we come to recognize his ideals. Finally we realize the spiritual reality of God. As these three stages come together, we form a personal relationship with God. Religious experience, through our relationship with God, lets us live a life on a higher level, and it helps us grow spiritually.
p5.022: God is the creator of all personality. Personality is not just energy or matter; it is a special quality that God has bestowed on human beings. Personality plays an important part in our relationship with God and in our experience of his love. God has given us personality, and through it we can have fellowship with him and grow.
p5.023: Personality is neither material nor spiritual. It is a special quality God has created, which lets human beings be aware of themselves and use their free will. Human personality comes from God, and it has the ability to receive his love and wisdom. And through their own choices, people can choose the path of spiritual growth.
p5.024: When we love God and follow his will, our personality grows spiritually. This happens within our relationship with God, and it leads us to become better beings. God treasures every personality, and according to their choices he prepares for them an eternal destiny. Human personality has an important part in God’s plan, and through our relationship with God we can be reborn as better beings.
p6.002: The Eternal Son is the Universal Father’s first thought and the absolute, perfect expression of that thought. The Son shows the nature of the Universal Father, and he has always existed together with the Father. Because it is hard to understand the beginning of the Son and the Father with our human idea of time, we use expressions like the Father’s “⟦Q 6:0.2⟧first thought⟦/Q⟧”. But the Eternal Son and the Father are beings who have no beginning and no end in time. The Eternal Son works together with the Universal Father as Creator, and their relationship is eternal and absolute. As mortals we cannot fully understand this relationship, but the Eternal Son has an important role in showing the Father’s spiritual qualities to human beings. He is the divine Word, the one who expresses the Father’s thought and will. In all the universes the Eternal Son dwells with the Father at the center of all creation and reveals its true nature.
p6.004: The Eternal Son is the only-begotten Son of the Universal Father, and he is called the divine Second Center. He works together with the Father in creating and managing the universe, and he has an important role in upholding the spiritual life of all creatures. The Eternal Son is the spiritual center and spiritual administrator of the whole universe, the one who carries out the Father’s will and plan throughout the universe. If the Father is the one who leads in creating and controlling the universe, the Son works together with him in that creation and is responsible for keeping up and developing spiritual order. The Bible verse “⟦Q 6:1.3⟧In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God⟦/Q⟧” points in truth to the Eternal Son. And when a Son of the Eternal Son appeared on Urantia in human form, people who saw him bore witness to his divinity, calling him “⟦Q 6:1.4⟧the Word of life⟦/Q⟧”. The Eternal Son is called by different names in all the universes, but his nature is always the same. In the central universe he is known as the co-creator, and in the local universes he is known through the Creator Sons, and his ministry is universal and eternal.
p6.006: Like the Father, the Eternal Son has unchanging faithfulness and infinite steadiness. Just like the Father, he is a spirit being who uses absolute spiritual power, and his nature is in complete agreement with the Father’s qualities. So whoever has seen the Son has, in a sense, seen the Father. The Eternal Son has the same spiritual qualities as the Father, and their personality and spiritual nature cannot be separated. The Eternal Son has a divine spirit nature, and his spiritual influence throughout the universe has no limit. He is more approachable for human beings, and his personal qualities can feel closer to us than the Father’s. The Son’s love and goodness are no different from the Father’s, and he shows the Father’s spiritual perfection to every creature in the universe. The Eternal Son reflects the Father’s will and oversees all spiritual happenings in the universe. His spiritual power and perfection work in the same way in all the universes, and as the eternal spiritual administrator he holds absolute influence.
p6.008: The Eternal Son is the personal expression of the Father’s love and mercy. If the Father is love, the Son is mercy. He shows the Father’s love to every creature, and through that love he carries out a ministry of mercy. The Father’s love is made real through the Eternal Son, and the Son reaches more deeply toward creatures to share mercy and love. The love the Son shows is no different from the Father’s, but the Son also has the ability to show mercy to creatures. This is because he not only took part with the Father in the work of creation, but as the Father’s Son he also has a closer relationship with all creatures. The Eternal Son’s love reaches throughout all the universes, and the mercy he shows is the very nature of his spiritual personality. His spiritual influence is carried to every creature through his love and mercy, and he is always carrying out a ministry of love and mercy. The Son’s mercy comes from his divine nature, and it shows the Father’s love in a more concrete way.
p6.010: The Eternal Son is closely connected with every spiritual reality in the universe. His spiritual power has absolute influence on all spirit beings, and his spirit gravity draws every spiritual reality in the universe. He is deeply connected with pure spirit beings, and his spiritual power works beyond time and space. The Eternal Son has complete control over all spiritual reality, and his spirit gravity affects every spirit creature in the universe. His all-powerfulness works only in the spiritual realm, but its influence has no limit. He knows everything about all universe happenings, and he knows perfectly every spiritual event and the condition of every creature. Together with the Father, the Eternal Son manages and controls all spiritual reality in the universe, and his spiritual presence and the Father’s work as one throughout the whole universe.
p6.012: The Eternal Son does not step in directly in the material world; his role is carried out only in the spiritual realm. He does not take part in the material side of creation, but in spiritual power he is all-powerful. The Son can create personality, but only in working together with the Father. He does not create personality on his own; he makes spirit creatures in partnership with the Father’s personality. The Son can also share the privilege of creation with the Creator Sons, but that authority has limits. A Creator Son cannot pass on the authority to create to other beings, and the power of creation is a special ability that the Father and the Son can use together. Also, the Eternal Son cannot fragment himself and share himself out to other beings, but his spiritual power can reach throughout the whole universe.
p6.014: The Eternal Son is a spirit being and also a being with mind, but his mind is different from the kind of mind mortal humans can understand. His mind works not on the material level but on the spiritual level, and this is something hard to grasp with our finite human way of thinking. Through his divine mind the Eternal Son communicates with the spirit beings of the universe, and his mind is in complete agreement with the Father’s mind. This mind belongs to the spiritual nature, and it is basically different from the human mind, which is joined to matter. The Eternal Son is aware of the identity of every spirit being, and his mind has the ability to recognize how spiritual realities relate to one another. This kind of mind is the very heart of divine communication, and through this mind the Eternal Son is connected with all the spirit beings of the universe.
p6.016: The Eternal Son is the one who expresses the infinite personality of the Universal Father, and his personality is absolute. He perfectly reflects the Father’s personality and nature, and his personality reveals divine nature to every creature. The personality of the Eternal Son is creative, and he shares his personality with every creature in the universe. As a minister of mercy and love, the Eternal Son pours out his personal love on every creature in the universe. He fully shows the Father’s spiritual personality, and because his personality is absolute, it cannot be separated or divided. He is an eternal being, and though it is hard for human beings to fully understand his personality, the beauty and greatness of that personality are recognized by all creatures.
p6.018: The Eternal Son is a personality equal to the Universal Father, and they complete each other perfectly. People may think of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son as separate beings, but in fact they are joined as one. In the management of the universe their roles are not separated; they keep a relationship in which they are woven together. The Eternal Son is an infinite being, but through his Paradise Sons mortals can communicate with him. These Sons, as Creator Sons, are connected with the Eternal Son and carry out the work of managing and creating the universe. It is hard for human beings to reach a full understanding of the Eternal Son, but through spiritual progress they come a little closer to his reality.
p7.002: The Eternal Son helps the Father’s eternal purpose come true, step by step, in the universe. The Son always takes a deep interest in this spiritual plan. Even though we do not know the whole of this plan, the Paradise Son understands it perfectly. The Eternal Son freely shares everything he has with the lower Sons, and he serves as the upholder of the spiritual world. He upholds all spirit beings and is responsible for creating and keeping up spirit realities. But the Son is not directly responsible for the actions that spirit beings decide on by their own free will. Even so, his control of spirit gravity is absolute, and the Son always keeps up the spiritual order of the universe.
p7.004: The Eternal Son is the center of all spirit gravity, and his spirit circuit works throughout the whole universe. This spirit gravity is not affected by time and space, and the spiritual values of the universe always return to the Son’s circuit. Spirit gravity works much like physical gravity, but it responds only to spiritual qualities. Just as material things respond to physical gravity, spiritual realities respond to spirit gravity and come under the Son’s control. This spirit gravity also works between creatures; it has a power that draws together those whose minds have been changed spiritually. This spirit circuit is absolute, so not even sin and rebellion can interfere with the Son’s spiritual control. For example, Urantia was spiritually isolated because of the Lucifer rebellion, yet the Son’s spirit circuit is still working. This circuit is predictable, and when we hold spiritual values, the Son responds to those values and draws us with his spirit gravity.
p7.005: 2. The Administration of the Eternal Son
p7.006: From Paradise, the Eternal Son carries out spiritual control throughout the universe. In Havona and the superuniverses, the Son’s personal activity becomes less and less, but his influence is still kept up. In the superuniverses the Son does not appear directly, but his spiritual control is still at work, and his superpersonal influence is present even though creatures do not see it. In the local universes the Son is personally present in the Paradise Sons, and through them he carries out spiritual creative activity. In this way the Eternal Son keeps up spiritual control everywhere in the universe, and his influence is essential. He has the role of bringing about the creative order and spiritual unity of the universe, and his control is a key part of keeping spiritual order.
p7.007: 3. Relation of the Eternal Son to the Individual
p7.008: In the local universe, mortals recognize the Creator Son as the representative of the Eternal Son. As they enter superuniverse training, mortals experience the spiritual influence of the Eternal Son more deeply. The Eternal Son does not indwell the minds of mortals, but he always cares about their welfare and spiritual progress. The spirit-gravity circuit has a key part in lifting mortal souls up to Paradise, and through spiritual experience mortals respond more and more to this gravity. Spiritual prayers and longings are also carried to the Son through this circuit, but requests with no spiritual value are not carried by it. This circuit sorts out the true spiritual value in a mortal’s life, and material prayers and requests are treated as spiritually worthless and fade away. A mortal’s true spiritual experience is carried to Paradise by this spirit-gravity circuit, and this is an important pathway of spiritual progress.
p7.010: The Eternal Son takes part as an eternal partner in the Father’s plan for making creatures perfect. This plan is to help will creatures reach perfection step by step. The first is the plan of progressive attainment, in which the Father and the Son help creatures evolve and grow. The second is the bestowal plan, in which the Son is bestowed to reveal the Father and to show creatures God’s love and mercy. In this process the Son overcomes difficulties such as rebellion and works to rescue creatures. The third is the plan of mercy ministry, in which the Infinite Spirit helps creatures through the ministry of mercy. These three plans are linked together, and through them the Son helps creatures reach spiritual perfection step by step.
p7.012: The Eternal Son comes close to creatures by bestowing his divine nature on them. He does not directly indwell creatures the way the Father does, but through the process of bestowal he is with creatures and guides them. He bestows himself many times to help creatures make spiritual progress, and in this way he lets them experience the Son’s divine nature. The Sons of the Eternal Son show creatures the divine love of the Father and the Son. These bestowals give mortals great spiritual strength, and they help them come closer and closer to the Son’s nature on their spiritual journey. In particular, when Michael of Nebadon, known as Jesus Christ, bestowed his divine personality on Urantia, mortals were able to experience God’s love and mercy directly.
p7.014: There are many Sons of God, and each kind serves creatures in a different way. The Eternal Son is the personal source of these Sons, and they all share the Son’s divine nature. The Creator Sons are beings created together by the Universal Father and the Eternal Son; they manage the local universes and carry out creative activity. They care for and guide the beings they have created, and they keep up the creative order of the universe. The Magisterial Sons are beings created together by the Son and the Spirit, and they are responsible for the survival and judgment of creatures. All of them have the Son’s spiritual nature and carry out important roles in the universe. They have an important part in carrying out God’s divine plan, and their activity is closely connected with the Eternal Son.
p7.015: 7. The Supreme Revelation of the Father
p7.016: The Eternal Son is the one who fully reveals the spiritual personality of the Universal Father. All knowledge of the Father can be gained through the Eternal Son, and the Son perfectly shows the Father’s personality and spiritual nature. The Eternal Son and his Sons are responsible for revealing the Universal Father, and through this they give creatures a way to come to the Father. Mortals can make their way to the Father with the Son’s guidance, and this has an important part in their spiritual journey. The Eternal Son is a personality equal to the Father, and he helps creatures grow spiritually.
p8.002: The Infinite Spirit is a divine being who comes from the joint action of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son. The Father’s first thought found its perfect expression in the Eternal Son, and through the action joined to that thought, the Infinite Spirit came into being. The Father and the Son made a divine pledge in their partnership, and this union lasts forever. In this way the Infinite Spirit appeared, and he is the one who carries out the united will and action of the Father and the Son. The coming of the Infinite Spirit in eternity is the natural result of the partnership of the Father and the Son, and the Infinite Spirit serves as the agent who makes their will real. As the Third Source and Center, he is eternal and infinite, just like the Father and the Son.
p8.004: When the Infinite Spirit was personalized, the circle of divine personality was complete. He is the God of action, using creative power to carry out the united plan of the Father and the Son. The Infinite Spirit’s first act is to recognize the Father and the Son and pledge his loyalty to them. He fully understands their united nature and infinite qualities, and by being subject to the Father and the Son he establishes his own role. The creative power of the Infinite Spirit breathes reality into space and creates the material world and the spiritual world at the same time. As the executive of the Paradise Trinity, he has the role of creating and upholding the universe. At this time the billion perfect spheres were created, and the material universe came into being.
p8.006: The Infinite Spirit perfectly reflects the nature of the Father and the Son. He is called by many names, but his true nature lies in universal ministry and service. He is called the Universal Spirit, the Conjoint Creator, the Divine Executive, and other names, and his role is to serve the created worlds and beings. The Infinite Spirit has all the qualities of the Father and the Son, and he is the one who puts their united love and mercy into action. His ministry is to carry to creatures the love and mercy that the Father and the Son show together. He reveals the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy, and in his service creatures receive divine help.
p8.007: 3. Relation of the Spirit to the Father and the Son
p8.008: The Infinite Spirit works as the one who carries out the first creative idea the Father and the Son made together. He has an important part in creating and upholding all the universes, and he works as the partner of the Father and the Son. Together with the Eternal Son, the Infinite Spirit plans and shapes every universe after Havona. In the local universe, the Creative Spirit of the Infinite Spirit manages creatures together with the Creator Son, and they carry out an important part in the process of creation that the Father and the Son planned. As the executive who makes real the united purpose of the Father and the Son, the Infinite Spirit has the important role of carrying the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy to every creature.
p8.010: The Infinite Spirit is a being who serves creatures, and his role is to reveal the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy to every intelligent creature. As the united expression of love and mercy, he serves created beings without ceasing and helps their spiritual progress. The Infinite Spirit’s ministry is carried out together with his spirit offspring, who have the role of serving and guiding created beings. He is with the Creator Sons as a tireless minister when they manage their universes. The Infinite Spirit carries out the mission of helping created beings in the local universes reach higher spiritual achievement, and he is devoted to supporting them on their spiritual journey.
p8.012: One of the greatest qualities of the Infinite Spirit is that he is present everywhere. He is in all the universes, and his influence works together with the spiritual power of the Father and the Son. The Infinite Spirit is present not only as himself but also through the spiritual presence of the Father and the Son, and his spiritual ministry touches every creature. The ministry of the Infinite Spirit, also called the Holy Spirit, appears in the local universe in the form of its Creative Spirit, and his spiritual influence reaches throughout the universe. All these different spiritual influences work as one united spiritual ministry, and creatures recognize it as “⟦Q 8:5.5⟧the spirit of God⟦/Q⟧”.
p8.014: Even though the Infinite Spirit is spread out as a universal presence, he is still a person. As a divine personality he is equal to the Father and the Son, and his personality is real. He has absolute mind, and he influences created beings directly. The Infinite Spirit communicates with creatures through his personality and meets their spiritual needs. His personal ministry is carried out throughout the universe, and he has the role of carrying the love of the Father and the Son to creatures. The personality of the Infinite Spirit perfectly reflects the united action and nature of the Father and the Son, and his ministry plays an essential part in helping creatures reach spiritual achievement.
p8.015: As the Conjoint Creator of the universe, the Infinite Spirit is the partner of the Father and the Son, and his personality has an important part in leading the spiritual growth of creatures.
p9.002: The Infinite Spirit is a divine being who came from the partnership of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son. He was personalized to carry out the work of controlling and unifying the spiritual and physical forces of the universe. He adjusts the energies of the universe, and he is in charge of the ministry that carries the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy. As a member of the Paradise Trinity, the Infinite Spirit has an important role in the universe; he is present in all space, and he is eternal. His influence responds to both spiritual reality and physical energy, and he has the ability to unify all actual universe energy and spiritual reality. The influence of the Infinite Spirit is essential for carrying out the divine plan of the Father and the Son.
p9.003: 1. Attributes of the Third Source and Center
p9.004: The Infinite Spirit has many qualities, and he is the result of the united action of the Father and the Son. He is called by many names, such as God the Spirit, the Universal Manipulator, and the Conjoint Actor, and his role is to carry out the plans of the Father and the Son and to co-ordinate the physical world and the spiritual world. Some of the qualities of the Third Source and Center come from the Father and others from the Son, but still others are unique and cannot be found in either the Father or the Son. The Infinite Spirit co-ordinates all actual reality, and he forever keeps the Father’s thought and the Son’s word. He is absolute in the realm of mind, and his all-powerfulness is shown only in the realm of mind.
p9.006: The Infinite Spirit is present throughout the whole universe, and he works in unity with the spiritual power of the Father and the Son. He shows his spiritual presence through the Father’s will and the Son’s word, and he gives spiritual power to every creature. This spiritual power becomes even stronger when the Father, the Son, and the Infinite Spirit work together. Human beings can experience the spiritual presence of the Infinite Spirit, and this presence can be felt in both the material world and the spiritual world. This presence comes from the Father, the Son, and the Infinite Spirit working together, and it has an important role in helping every creature grow spiritually.
p9.008: The Infinite Spirit has a close relationship with the Isle of Paradise, and he has the ability to control physical gravity. He has the unique ability to use antigravity, which works against gravity, and it works in interaction with physical gravity. He uses this ability to adjust and neutralize the energies of the material world, and it has an important part in keeping physical balance. He uses the power of Paradise to co-ordinate physical creation and to help creatures keep order. This physical activity of the Infinite Spirit shows that he serves as a co-ordinator who controls energy and force.
p9.010: The mind of the Infinite Spirit is absolute, and this shows his intellectual nature. His mind touches every creature in all the universes, and it co-ordinates the relationship between energy and spirit. Mind has the role of setting up the relationship between energy and spirit, and its nature applies both to spiritual reality and to physical reality. The mind of the Infinite Spirit has no time, and it has abilities that go beyond space. He shares mind with every creature, and this helps them grow and develop. The mind of the Infinite Spirit brings balance between energy and spirit, and it has an important part in helping creatures reach their goals.
p9.012: The Infinite Spirit is the one who gives mind to every creature. His mind has an important role in helping created beings make spiritual progress, and he shares that mind with creatures such as human beings. The human mind is part of the cosmic mind of the Infinite Spirit, and through it people can experience creative thinking and consciousness. His mind is bestowed on every intelligent being, and it touches everyone from material living things to high spirit beings. This ministry of mind works throughout the universe, and it plays an essential part in the spiritual progress of every being.
p9.014: The Infinite Spirit has the mind-gravity circuit, which connects all the minds in the whole universe. This circuit connects the minds of all creatures and co-ordinates their intellectual activity. Through the mind-gravity circuit he keeps personal contact with creatures throughout the universe and takes care of all the intellectual values they have. Mind gravity can work independently of physical gravity and spirit gravity, and through this circuit all true thinking and divine thought are connected. The mind-gravity circuit of the Infinite Spirit is an important means of universal control and harmony.
p9.016: Through universe reflectivity the Infinite Spirit has the ability to gather and pass on all information at the same time. Universe reflectivity is aware of all physical, spiritual, and intellectual activity, so that every event can be seen from one place. This happening shows up clearly at the superuniverse headquarters, and it co-ordinates the interactions of all creatures. Reflectivity is also closely connected with the Supreme Being, and it gives the ability to handle information through a universal consciousness. Through it the universe rulers can know about events happening far away as they happen.
p9.018: The Infinite Spirit shares his power with many beings. The Seven Master Spirits and the Creative Spirits are direct creations of the Infinite Spirit, and they work in the superuniverses and the local universes, carrying out the ministry of the Infinite Spirit. The personalities of the Infinite Spirit also carry out many kinds of ministry and help creatures grow spiritually. These personalities work on Paradise, in the central universe, in the superuniverses, and in the local universes, and their activity centers on service for the spiritual progress of creatures.
p10.002: The Paradise Trinity is the divine reality in which the Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit are united as one. The Trinity joins the Father’s infinite will with absoluteness and perfection, and so fully expresses the divine nature. The Trinity is a basic principle of the universe, and through this union the Universal Father escapes from personal absoluteness. The Trinity brings the work of the Father and the Son into harmony, and it keeps divine unity and order in the universe. This Trinity has a central part in all the activities of the universe and its creatures, and it upholds their existence.
p10.003: 1. Self-Distribution of the First Source and Center
p10.004: To express his infinite nature, the Universal Father shared out his power to the Son and the Infinite Spirit. He delegates all his authority to the Creator Sons and allows them to manage their own universes. The Father shares his love and divine qualities with all the beings he has created, and he seeks to carry out his will through his Sons. This sharing out comes from divine free will, and in the process of sharing his infinite nature, the Father bestowed personal absoluteness on the Eternal Son. Through this divine process of sharing, human beings can understand God’s nature.
p10.006: The Universal Father bestows his nature on the Eternal Son, and the Son becomes the personal expression of the Father. As a result, the Infinite Spirit came into being and exists as a divine personality in whom the Father and the Son are united. These three personalities give personality to every creature in the universe, and the Father is always forming personal relationships with creatures. The Father, the Son, and the Spirit each exist as independent personalities, yet they work as one perfectly harmonized divine reality. Through this divine union, all creative activity in the universe takes place.
p10.008: Although there is one Deity, within it there are three independent personalities. The Father as the Creator, the Son as the Word, and the Spirit as the Actor each have their own role. These three personalities are equal to one another, but they manage the universe through different roles. The Father is the source of creation, the Son is his expression, and the Spirit puts the will of the Father and the Son into action. These three personalities are active in the universe both one by one and together, and their united activity forms the Trinity.
p10.010: The Trinity is the divine union of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit. This union carries out roles that would be impossible for them one by one, and it works as a power that brings divine unity to the universe. The members of the Trinity can act as individual personalities, but only when they act together can they fully show the functions of total Deity. The Trinity goes beyond the personal level and shows a divine union that has to do with all universe events, and its results appear throughout the universe.
p10.012: The Trinity has many functions, such as justice, totality, union, and universal control. The functions of the Trinity have to do with every event in the universe, and they center on keeping divine unity and harmony. The functions of the Trinity are not just a collection of qualities; they are new meanings and values that come from the united ministry of the divine beings. These functions keep up the order and progress of the universe, and they help every creature grow under the influence of the Trinity.
p10.013: 6. The Stationary Sons of the Trinity
p10.014: The stationary Sons who come from the Trinity have the role of carrying out justice. These Sons are in charge of announcing and explaining the law, and they carry the justice of the Trinity to creatures. They carry out the Trinity’s will on the basis of fairness and justice, and they bring mercy and love into harmony. The Sons of the Trinity keep law and order, and they carry out the important role of making divine justice real in the universe.
p10.016: The Trinity holds the highest control in the universe, and that control shows itself through the Supreme Being. The Trinity co-ordinates and unifies the whole universe, and its control leads the development and growth of every creature. The Supreme Being reflects the control of the Trinity, and he has an important part in the process of universe evolution. The control of the Trinity co-ordinates every event in the universe, and its results affect the spiritual progress of creatures.
p10.018: The Trinity works beyond the finite level, on levels higher than the finite as well. The functions of the Trinity reach as far as the ultimate and the absolute, and its control is equal to the functions of total Deity. The Trinity works on levels beyond the finite that finite creatures cannot understand, and its influence stretches out to infinite levels. The nature of the Trinity is perfect, and it gives a divine purpose to everything it creates.
p11.002: Paradise is the center of the universe, where the Universal Father, the Eternal Son, the Infinite Spirit, and their divine associates dwell. This central Isle is both material and spiritual, and of all the realities in the universe it is the largest and most perfectly organized body. Paradise is a material world and also a spiritual home, the center of the Universal Father’s creative activity. Paradise, where material perfection and spiritual greatness are joined, is a mysterious place that is hard to understand. Its beauty and divinity cannot be fully understood by the material human mind. And there is no record at all of where Paradise came from; it is thought of as a place that has existed from eternity.
p11.004: Paradise is first of all the place where Deity dwells. The presence of the Universal Father is at the center of Paradise, with the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit around him. This is where the Universal Father dwells forever, and we can always find him there. Paradise is located at the center of the universe, and the gravity and energy of all creation gather there. Although Paradise is far away and not easy for human beings to reach, with spiritual guidance we can at last stand before the Father’s glory. Even though only a few beings have reached Paradise so far, its reality is beyond doubt. The Father can always be found at this center, and from his presence life and energy flow out into the universe.
p11.006: Paradise is a fixed reality, the largest and most absolute material body in the universe. This central Isle is shaped like an ellipse, longer from north to south than from east to west. Paradise is made of absolute material, and it has a unique organization found nowhere else in the universe. The material of Paradise is neither living nor dead; it is thought of as the first nonspiritual expression of the Universal Father. It is not limited by time and space, and it is an eternal reality in itself. Paradise is also divided into three parts: upper, nether, and peripheral Paradise. The upper part is where personal activities take place, and the nether part is where physical forces and energies are concentrated.
p11.008: Upper Paradise is divided into three main areas of activity. The first is the area of the presence of Deity, the second is the Most Holy Sphere, and the third is the Holy Area. It is mainly a place for spiritual activities, and physical beings or merely intellectual creatures cannot live there. The Most Holy Sphere is a place for worship and high spiritual achievement, and its beauty is beyond human understanding. The Holy Area is a region that keeps many historical mementos and physical reminders, and the natives of the superuniverses and the citizens of Paradise live there. It is a place for the spiritual progress of creatures, and the holy realms of Paradise become the goal of spiritual achievement for countless ascending beings.
p11.010: The periphery of Paradise is where all the personalities traveling through space land and take off. Unlike upper Paradise, where personal activities take place, this area is a center of activity for moving spirit beings. Here there are seven trillion historic exhibit areas, spaces made ready for the superuniverses and the creations beyond them. Right now the periphery of Paradise is a space for creative activity, and it has an almost infinite capacity. This vast region of Paradise is ready to hold creative activity beyond time and space, and plenty of room is still left for creations yet to come.
p11.012: Nether Paradise is a place where no personalities live; it is the center of physical energy and space potential. It is thought of not as a place of the Trinity’s personal control but as the gathering place of cosmic force and energy. Nether Paradise is where physical force comes from, and the physical energies throughout the universe go out from here and come back again. It is the center where all the physical force and energy of the universe circulate, the focus of the force-energy activities of Paradise. Space respiration also comes from nether Paradise, which governs the cycles in which space and energy contract and expand. The activities of nether Paradise are closely connected with the physical energies of the universe.
p11.014: Space respiration means the expanding and contracting of space in all the universes. Pervaded space and unpervaded space contract and expand in cycles, and this process is governed from the nether side of Paradise. One cycle of space respiration takes about two billion years, and it affects all the physical universes. These breathing cycles have an important part in adjusting physical force and energy throughout the universe, and they keep the universe stable. Unpervaded space reaches out to the north and south of Paradise, and it helps govern the expansion and contraction of the universe. This breathing cycle helps cosmic force and energy stay in balance.
p11.016: Paradise is not located in space, yet it serves as the center of all space. Paradise works as a midway zone between pervaded space and unpervaded space, and it has the important role of separating these two kinds of space. Paradise is the only place with absolute space functions, and cosmic force and energy are concentrated there. The location of Paradise also governs the physical force and energy of the universe, and it is the center of all space activity. It is the place where pervaded and unpervaded space interact, and it has an important part in managing the expansion and contraction of space.
p11.018: Paradise is the center of all physical gravity throughout the universe. The gravity of Paradise pulls on all material reality and controls every physical force at work in the universe. This gravity comes from the physical center of Paradise, and it affects all the material worlds. Paradise gravity is also absolute, and its pull follows the physical laws of the universe. The energy and matter throughout the universe are adjusted by this Paradise gravity, and its activity is absolute. All physical force and energy come out from Paradise and go back to it.
p11.020: Paradise holds a unique place as both the destination and the place of origin for every being in the universe. Paradise is the place spiritual personalities must finally reach, and it is the center of all creative activity. Paradise is eternal and infinite, a place where the divine will of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son has taken form. Paradise is not personal, yet it is the pattern for all creative activity and the final destiny of all personal beings.
